description: Low-level 3-way in-core file merge implementation for Git, including built-in and external merge drivers, attribute handling, and merge result processing.

classes.name: ll_merge_driver
classes.description: Structure representing a merge driver, including its name, description, command line, and function pointer.

methods.name: load_merge_attributes
methods.description: Initializes and loads merge attribute checks, particularly conflict marker size.

methods.name: reset_merge_attributes
methods.description: Frees and resets merge attribute checks.

methods.name: ll_binary_merge
methods.description: Performs a built-in binary merge, choosing the result based on merge options.

methods.name: ll_xdl_merge
methods.description: Performs a built-in 3-way text merge using xdiff, falling back to binary merge if files are binary or too large.

methods.name: ll_union_merge
methods.description: Performs a union merge favoring all changes.

methods.name: create_temp
methods.description: Creates a temporary file with the contents of a given mmfile_t.

methods.name: ll_ext_merge
methods.description: Executes a user-defined external merge driver command.

methods.name: read_merge_config
methods.description: Reads merge configuration from git config, setting up merge drivers.

methods.name: initialize_ll_merge
methods.description: Initializes merge driver configurations from git config.

methods.name: find_ll_merge_driver
methods.description: Finds a merge driver based on attribute or default settings.

methods.name: normalize_file
methods.description: Normalizes file buffer for consistent line endings.

methods.name: ll_merge
methods.description: Main function to perform a merge using the appropriate driver based on attributes.

methods.name: ll_merge_marker_size
methods.description: Determines the conflict marker size attribute for a given file.
